summary: Agent 0.28.0 (same unreleased v0.26.0 as the configuration-key check of ADR-0051) refuses signed downgrades (ADR-0054, TM-13). Updater.verifyOrder compares the signed manifest version (after the Ed25519 check, never the unsigned order field alone) with the running release via downgradeRefusal; an older or non-release target is refused with errDowngrade and reported as update kind 'downgrade' through updateKind (no message parsing). update.allow_downgrade, a field of the existing update block in the node-local YAML and out of the router's reach, permits a deliberate rollback; it is a known field, so the strict top-level key check of ADR-0051 is unaffected. A local 'dev' build is not checked. Version parsing accepts only MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH digits (max 6 per field, no overflow). The router keeps retrying a refused order after 6 h (agentupdate.retry_after), which is benign. Signing-key rotation and recovery stay open, so TM-13 stays open in the register. Rebased onto main after #91 and #93; German texts follow main's spelling.

findings.evidence: agent 0.27.0 Updater.verifyOrder refused only the running version; any older validly signed manifest was installable.
findings.resolution: Anti-rollback implemented and tested (agent/updater.go, updater_test.go); signing-key rotation and recovery remain open, so the risk stays open.

tests.command: cd agent && gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
tests.evidence: gofmt clean, vet clean, ok github.com/psewar/skirnir/agent, including TestDowngradeRefusal and TestUpdaterVerifyOrderRefusesSignedDowngrade.

tests.command: Negative check (before rebase): go test -run Downgrade with the previous agent/updater.go
tests.evidence: FAIL [build failed]: unknown field AllowDowngrade in struct literal of type UpdateCfg; the old updater has no downgrade protection.

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/check_adr_index.py; python test/selftest_threat_review.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 54 ADRs; threat review self-test completed.

limitations: Agent tests ran on Windows locally; Linux and the Windows cross-build run in CI.
Signing-key rotation and recovery are not part of this change.
